Subject: Acme - Rerank model fit follow-up & next steps

Hi Tom / Sana 1

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and recommended next steps so we can validate model fit for your search/rerank workload: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: increase relevance for ecommerce search (product discovery) without hurting latency SLA (95p < 120ms).
- Current baseline: internal log sampling suggests our baseline model gets NDCG@10 = 0.625, MRR = 0.42 on your gold set.
- Concern: brief examples where the reranker demotes commercial intent results.

Redwood recommendation (pilot)
- Candidate models to validate: redwood-rerank-3b-quant and open-rerank-7b (quantized).
- Evaluation plan: run offline eval on a 50k query sample (50k queries, 3k labelled pairs) using your provided prompt_set_v1.csv.
- Metrics: NDCG@10 primary, MRR secondary; monitor precision@1 for intent-sensitive queries. Target improvement: +0.02 NDCG and no more than 1% regression in precision@1 for intent class.
- A/B plan: 1 week A/B with 20% traffic to model variant if offline results meet thresholds. Full ramp if +0.02 NDCG and latency impact < 5ms median.

Attachments & links
- I attached a brief AB test plan (ab_test_plan.md) and the prompt set we discussed (prompt_set_v1.csv).
- Benchmark dashboard: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cReRankBench

Open questions / asks for Acme
- Confirm the sample: can we run the 50k offline eval on your staging logs? If yes, share read-only S3 path or allow Redwood to pull.
- Confirm KPI thresholds 1 above target (+0.02 NDCG) OK?
- Please loop in procurement (Sana) for the pilot contract if needed.

Next steps
- If you approve sample access, Dev will kick off the offline run and Marcus will share the NDCG/MRR report (ETA 48 hours).
- I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Wed/Thu this week for data handoff and to walk through the AB plan.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Marissa / Tom 1 quick technical follow-up and I attached the initial offline report (rerank_ndcg_mrr_report_q2.pdf). Notes: 

- Baseline numbers: we re-ran the baseline on a 10k seed of your labelled set to sanity-check: NDCG@10 = 0.627, MRR = 0.421. Minor sampling variance vs. your numbers, within expected noise.
- Candidate model snapshots: redwood-rerank-3b-quant shows +0.018 NDCG on the 10k seed and near-zero median latency change (+2ms). open-rerank-7b shows +0.028 NDCG but +12ms median latency.
- Quality regressions: we flagged ~120 queries (of 10k) where intent-sensitive hits moved down. Most are low-frequency long-tail queries; we recommend adding a constrained rerank rule for the 'purchase_intent' intent class during live AB to avoid regressions.

AB plan highlights (attached ab_test_plan.md)
- Offline pass threshold: candidate must hit +0.02 NDCG on the 50k sample and have precision@1 regression < 0.5% for commerce-intent cohort.
- Traffic split: 20% treatment (candidate), 80% control; 1 week sampling (min 200k impressions).
- Gate checks: daily NDCG/MRR and live precision@1 for intent cohort; automatic rollback if precision@1 drops >0.75% or latency P95 degrades >15ms.

Action items from our side
- If Acme provides S3 access, we'll queue the 50k run (ETA ~48 hours compute; cost estimate attached in report).
- I'll also push a prompt-set sensitivity run to see if prompt variants reduce the flagged regressions.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Applied ML | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
